title: DatasetConfig
description: CONTRACTS §9 — dataset configuration (input contract), validated by this schema BEFORE any profiling starts. Unknown/unvalidatable config or rule keys are hard errors (additionalProperties=false everywhere per §9); GX-style shape only, no GX dependency (ADR-012). YAML source is parsed to this JSON shape before validation; `value` semantics (e.g. missing_rate_max threshold 0.05 = fraction) stay engine-side per ENGINE §5.1.

config_version.description: CONTRACTS §9 example carries `config_version: 3` (integer). The config hash lands later on ProfilingRun.config (§2).

primary_key.description: Declared PK columns; enables uniqueness/key checks without guessing (ENGINE §5 §orchestration point 4).

units.description: Per-column unit assertions, keyed by column name. status shares the ColumnProfile.unit.status enum (CONTRACTS §3.2) — never silently assert.

sampling.description: enabled=true requires strategy+size+seed — same reproducibility lock as ProfilingRun.sampling (§2), key name is `size` per the §9 example.

sections.description: Requested profile sections (ENGINE orchestration §5 point 2; §9 example: schema, descriptive_statistics, missing_values, uniqueness, distributions). Names are resolved by the metric registry at planning time — unknown entries are rejected there, not by this input schema.

rule.title: DatasetConfigRule
rule.description: CONTRACTS §9 rule entry; ENGINE §5.1 MVP catalog. Extractable $def per schema-pack convention so rule-level validation can run standalone.
Closed MVP catalog (ENGINE §5.1). referential_integrity/date_order are declared Phase 2/deep — valid config, gated at execution.

dimension.description: REQUIRED for scorecard rollup (§9 bullet 1; ENGINE §5.4). Same enum as QualityCheckResult.dimension (§4.1).

value.description: Rule parameter; shape depends on `rule` type (bound, fraction, allowed set — per §9 example written inline as `value:`). Semantics enforced by the rule compiler (M2-T7), not this schema.

threshold.description: Alternative threshold slot from the GX-style shape (§5.1 declares `threshold` as a rule attribute); `value`/`threshold` are both permitted, neither mandatory in the generic case.

condition.description: Matcher for conditional rules; required when rule == conditional_not_null (§9 example, ENGINE §5.2 compiled FILTER).

business_note.description: Semantics-aware handling hint, e.g. negative revenue valid for refunds → review not hard-fail (§9 bullet 2; ENGINE §5.3 WARN).

allOf.description: Threshold-carrying bounds/rate rules must provide their parameter (per-type enforcement is M2-T7 compiler; the §9 exemplars must validate).
